whenToUse: Single-line and multi-line text entry; Field wraps any control with label, hint and error.
Fieldset to group related fields with a legend.
avoidWhen: Formatted business values (money, phone, IBAN) — use Formatted inputs.
Picking from options — use Select or Combobox.
a11y: Always wrap in Field with a visible label; placeholders are not labels.
Errors are linked with aria-describedby and set aria-invalid.
